expectedInputFacts.freshArrayProof: each fill follows exactly one new-array of a known sufficient constant length, on a single-entry acyclic normal chain with no call, handler, field/array write, publication or return in between

certificationObligations: The independent projection proves the int/float fresh-array shape and payload item by item: two new-array sites, two fill-array-data payloads with element_width 4 and no handler.
The implementation must not infer from Java literal text that the original DEX contained a fill; the DEX payload is the input fact.
The reference Java mirror and the original DEX payload must agree on every element value and every float bit pattern, including -0.0.
The mirror derivation covers the single new array, a known sufficient length, constant elements and no escape or handler; it is not a general exception or lock VM.
